crossRefs.note: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at…
and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because…
Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
“Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.

translations.web: “The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved.”
translations.bsb: “The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, but we have not been saved.”
